list.title: Rooms
list.empty: You haven’t joined a room yet. Use “Browse rooms” to find one.
list.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
list.choose: Choose a room, or browse the rooms.

browse.title: Browse rooms
browse.intro: Rooms the association opened for its members. When you join a room, the people in it see your name.
browse.membersOnly: Rooms are for members with an active membership.

join.title: Join {name}?
join.text: The people in this room will see your first and last name, also if you are not listed in the member directory. You can leave at any time.
join.banned: You were removed from this room and can’t join it now.
join.notJoined: Join this room to read it and write in it.

room.blocked: A message from someone you blocked.
room.left: You are no longer in this room.

cannot.notJoined: Join this room to write in it.
cannot.membersOnly: Your membership isn’t active, so you can read this room but not write in it.
cannot.suspended: The association’s staff suspended you from sending messages. You can still read.
cannot.archived: This room is archived. It can be read, and nothing more can be written.
cannot.locked: A moderator locked this room. Only moderators can write now.
cannot.lockedUntil: A moderator locked this room until {when}. Only moderators can write now.
cannot.moderatorsOnly: This is an announcements room. Only moderators write here.

composer.announcement: Send as an announcement (the room is told)
composer.mentionHint: Type @ and a name to mention someone in the room.

menu.removePerson: Remove the writer from the room
menu.banPerson: Ban the writer from the room

details.title: About this room
details.muteForever: Muted until I switch it back

leave.title: Leave {name}?
leave.text: What you wrote stays in the room. You can join again later.

report.title: Report the room {name}
report.intro: The association’s staff will see what you write here, and can open the room.

moderate.title: Moderation
moderate.removeMessageText: Everyone will see “Removed by a moderator” in its place. This is recorded and can’t be undone.
moderate.removePersonText: They leave the room now and may join again.
moderate.banText: They leave the room now and can’t join it until the ban ends or is lifted.
moderate.daysHint: 1 to 365. Leave empty to ban until it is lifted.

admin.title: Chat rooms
admin.intro: Rooms the association opens for its members. A room is archived, never deleted.

editor.archiveHint: It leaves the lists and becomes read-only for the people in it.

moderators.title: Moderators
moderators.intro: A moderator is an active member. Someone who is not in the room yet is added to it.
moderators.none: This room has no moderator yet.
moderators.search: Find a member by name or email

categories.title: Room categories
categories.intro: What rooms are grouped by on “Browse rooms”.
categories.keyHint: Capital letters, digits and underscores, for example CONFERENCES. It can’t be changed later.

reasons.title: Report reasons
reasons.intro: The reasons a member chooses from when reporting. A reason is switched off, not deleted, because old reports name it.
